title: Six Figs and a Pig
lines: Tim has six figs in a tin.
Tim hid the tin in a bin.
A pig got in the bin!
The pig did not fit. It is big.
The pig tips the bin and sits.
His figs sit in the mud.
Tim is sad. But the pig digs.
The pig digs up a big fig.

questions.ask: Where did Tim hide the tin?
questions.listenFor: In a bin. It is said in the story. If they guess, have them find the word bin and read that line again.

questions.ask: How did the figs end up in the mud?
questions.listenFor: The pig got in the bin and tipped it over. Two steps, so it is fine to look back for both parts.

questions.ask: Do you think Tim is still cross with the pig at the end? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer. You want a reason from the story - the pig dug a fig back up, or the pig wrecked the tin in the first place.
